commands.name: view-flights
commands.title: View Flights
commands.description: View all Flights saved in the Flighty app

tools.name: search-flights
tools.title: Search Flights
tools.description: Look up your saved Flighty flights by flight number, airline, route, and departure date, including upcoming and past trips.

tools.name: get-flight
tools.title: Get Flight Details
tools.description: Get a saved Flighty flight by ID, including scheduled, estimated, and actual times, terminals, gates, baggage belt, aircraft, booking code, and seat.

" && exit 1
